text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's first three years of
running in
the Twinkle Series have come
to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she has already achieved many
great things...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O! What race are you
going to
run in next?! Are you looking
for a rematch with
Maruzensky?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you promised Yaeno and
Ardan that
you'll run in a certain G1
race with them?! Do you
secretly have
any other rivals?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
O-oh my gosh... U-um... One question at
a time,
please!

text_block_list.name: School Girl A
text_block_list.text: Chiyo! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Aaahhh, you're sooo cute! You really are
like the
sweetheart of the nation! Lemme
hug you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: H-hug me?! The nation's what?! Uh... Th-thank you? I think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks... Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O! Can you watch me the next
time I
train and give me some tips,
please?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair! She'll watch me first!
Right,
Chiyo?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yep, that's me! Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! Help!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been treating me differently
lately!
They're suddenly praising me like
there's no
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that public interest in Sakura
Chiyono O
has been skyrocketing lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The school even received a proposal to turn her story into a TV series titled The Tale of Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't a prank, is it? Or a dream?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What? Really? I still can't believe what's
been
going on, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's been all about the Eternal
Top Three
until recently. But now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But Maruzen's been stealing the show
just as
much on the track!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't the magazine and TV reporters
be
going to her instead?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? I'm just going out on a limb
here, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Could it be I'm actually pretty amazing?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You've stolen everyone's
hearts, and
that's why they're all over
you, Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So how about a li'l scrimmage? Your
trainer's
given you the A-OK already.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So how about a li'l scrimmage? Your
trainer's
given you the A-OK already.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
R-really, Trainer?! Is it okay with you if I
run with
Maruzen?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay! Okay, let's do it, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to put the pedal to the metal!
Now show
me just how strong you've
gotten, Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Really, really strong! I won't be losing
today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My... Hehe! That's my line. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Go ahead and give us the signal!
Ready,
set...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you don't want to run
with them as
well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not now. I shall wait until it is time for
the real
race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My desire to defeat them will only grow
stronger
with time—and so will I.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is the same for you, is it not, Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is... Hehe. We're rivals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Sakura Chiyono O run with
Maruzensky.
To her, this is the
continuation of her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I went back in time and told her past
self this is
how things would turn out, I
don't think she would
believe me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The first time I saw her run, I knew I
wanted to be
like her—to someday stand
as her equal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how mediocre an
Umamusume I am,
this is the one dream I
never want to give up on...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of Sakura Chiyono O's
race, I hear
the voice of an Umamusume
I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna run against her. If I run as
earnestly as
her...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll start to find racing fun too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is now in a position to
inspire
dreams in others.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo! Sorry, but can you sign more
autographs
for me? People keep asking
for them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! I just gave you a hundred the
other day,
and they're gone already?!
You're kidding!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm not! If that's too much work, then use
your
handprint! Just slap your hand on a
piece of
paper like your dad used to!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Seriously? Hm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll sign them all properly. They
asked for
my autograph and not my
handprint, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And I don't want to let them down!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you, dear.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Chiyo? I've been thinking about
how you
always say you're nothing but
ordinary...

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But I believe it's because you're so
"ordinary" that
you've been able to
become the star everyone
dreams of.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You started as a normal Umamusume,
but you
still worked your way up to be a
special, shining
star. So, Chiyo... Keep
doing your best, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... Hehe, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Despite being mediocre, I longed to be

extraordinary. I met people who
supported me
and was able to make my
special dream come
true.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(And I know who I have to thank for
that.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You can make dessert even with a ladle
and
pot"...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's a good proverb. I need to
write that
down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Sakura Chiyono O's grand tale
continues...
